# YouWontDare

> Dare your friends to do wild things and make them prove it — or chicken out.

YouWontDare is a free group dare app at https://youwontdare.xyz. Users create dare boards, challenge friends, and upload photo/video proof of completion.

## What it does

- Personal dare boards: share your link and let anyone dare you
- Group dare boards: everyone dares each other with leaderboards and badges
- Proof system: upload photos or videos to prove you completed a dare
- Chicken out: publicly admit defeat if you can't do it
- Anonymous dares with optional reveal
- Hype system, emoji reactions, and spice ratings
- Push notifications when you get dared
- Installable as a mobile app (PWA)

## Use cases

- Stag dos / bachelor parties
- Hen parties / bachelorette weekends
- Frat weekends and sorority events
- Freshers week / orientation week
- Work socials and team building
- Friend group challenges
- Holiday and travel dares
- Birthday party games
- Festival and concert dares
- Sports team initiations and bonding

## How it works

1. Sign up free at https://youwontdare.xyz
2. Create a personal board or a group board
3. Share the link with friends
4. Submit dares for each other
5. Complete dares by uploading proof (photo/video)
6. Track who's fearless and who's a chicken on the leaderboard

## Key features

- Free to use, no ads
- Works on any device (phone, tablet, desktop)
- Installable as a native-feeling app
- Dark themed UI with party/arcade aesthetic
- Sound effects (airhorn on completion, chicken sound on chicken out)
- Confetti animations on dare completion
- Sharable proof cards for social media
- Deadline countdowns on dares
- QR codes for easy board sharing
